scope: public INKWAVE runtime, including effective build composition

changes.bottleneck: Every live colour/matte slot was rewritten and scheduled for upload every frame although it stays constant between birth, recycling and swap deletion.
changes.implementation: Track dirty slot bounds, write only those colours, preserve the union of pending upload ranges, reset tracking on clear/reinitialization.
changes.expected_effect: Less CPU attribute work and GPU buffer traffic during effect bursts; no additional per-droplet buffers.
changes.verified_local_result: Stable live colours: 16 bytes per droplet per update to zero scheduled colour bytes. Single new or swapped slot: 16 scheduled bytes. Position/velocity attribute updates remain unchanged. These are attribute-range/model observations, not actual WebGL transfer or FPS measurements.

changes.bottleneck: First paint on an offscreen chart dirtied and regenerated the visible source-order triangle index stream.
changes.implementation: Record painted bits, but defer visible index invalidation when the chart has no triangles in the current visible tile set. Existing camera/transform/new-tile/toggle invalidation remains active.
changes.expected_effect: Fewer CPU index scans and GPU index upload requests when distant battles paint additional charts.
changes.verified_local_result: Focused observable regression keeps index.version unchanged for offscreen paint and reveals exactly the original ordered triangles after camera movement. No shader or atlas equation changed.

changes.bottleneck: Boolean LOS continued all candidate intersections and computed nearest-hit point, normal and UV after an occluder was already known.
changes.implementation: Explicit anyHit option after the existing candidate-column argument; only LOS uses early return after the unchanged slab acceptance test. Normal raycasts and native overrides retain their paths.
changes.expected_effect: Lower CPU work for occluded bot, aim and visibility queries.
changes.verified_local_result: Fixed 64-candidate occlusion fixture visits 64 to 1 candidates. This is an operation count, not CPU timing or FPS.

changes.bottleneck: Each curve clamped a time value already bounded by its clip.
changes.implementation: Validate full clip-domain coverage once when constructing the clip layout, skip redundant curve clamps only for qualifying clips, retain the general path for custom domains.
changes.expected_effect: Less CPU arithmetic per character pose without reducing update frequency or changing poses.
changes.verified_local_result: All 39,799 bound shipped curves qualify. WalkHold sampling Math.min calls 81 to 1; matching Math.max clamps are removed. All 548 clips and 1,644 sampled poses match the frozen oracle exactly across raw/local/world values. No FPS or CPU timing measured.

changes.bottleneck: Temporary fallback/copied/work arrays and callbacks were allocated for each render-time safety check.
changes.implementation: Validate scalar and tint components directly, keeping live in-place mutations, finite/nonnegative guards and RGBA fallback decisions.
changes.expected_effect: Lower transient allocation and CPU/GC work each rendered frame. Render targets, pass order, colour precision and image settings are unchanged.
changes.verified_local_result: Scalar/tint/boundary/mutation cases and existing packed/fallback/resize/lifetime cases pass. No device performance measurement.

changes.bottleneck: Every replicated event created a literal type array; hit-authority checks created a filter result and callback.
changes.implementation: Use equivalent ordered strict comparisons and a scalar field-count loop.
changes.expected_effect: Less transient allocation and CPU/GC work when combat events arrive in bursts. Payloads, ordering and rejection conditions stay unchanged.
changes.verified_local_result: Existing network hardening and composed hit packet regressions pass. No packet protocol or timing change.

validation.upstream_compatibility: node scripts/check-inkwave-patches.mjs --quick: passed; only the two changed locked sources were reviewed and repinned; numeric reference 11.3.0 unchanged
validation.test_registration: New FX test registered in queue-recovery; suite dry-run and one focused registration contract pass
validation.test_limits: No full suite, CI execution, production build, browser setup, repeated benchmark or match play. One native targeted invocation initially failed during a concurrent adapter edit and succeeded after that edit stabilized.
validation.independent_review: Native ink invalidation and LOS early return independently reviewed without repeating tests.

remaining_limitations: Five existing native-asset tests skipped because the optional native stage assets are unavailable in this checkout.
No real-device/browser pixel comparison or production output build was performed; verification is limited to focused logic, attribute-range, lifecycle and composed-source checks.
No new critical issue identified in the verified scope; maximum practical FPS and complete regression freedom are not established by these checks.
reviewed_without_changes: Audio listener/loop deduplication, prewarming and voice/cache resource limits already present.
Character FK branch updates, hair spring caches and HUD/minimap scratch objects already present.
Network wipeout history recomputation already has a receipt-aware cache.
Constant animation curves optimization rejected because none of the shipped bound curves has one key.
Tiny audio positivity shortcut rejected because it changes underflow behavior.
